quantitative_overrides.fin_note: Dominant North American home-improvement and Pro building-materials duopolist: Operating ROIC of 59.44% (GAAP median 41.53%) normalized to standard 35.0% cap, neutralizing $32.7B of goodwill from SRS Distribution/GMS acquisitions. Peak Owner EPS of $16.69 (FY2022) reflects normalized through-the-cycle earning power; recent dip to $14.23 is cyclical trough from 30-year low housing turnover and elevated mortgage rates. 5-10Y secular growth anchored at 6.5%: R&R/Pro volume (+2.5%), pricing/ticket (+2.0%), SRS cross-sell (+1.0%), wholesale margin/tariff drag (-0.5%), and normalized post-deleveraging buybacks (+1.5%). Raw PAR multiple of 22.86x is bound by the 5-Year Cycle High Guardrail at 22.44x. At 20.58x peak Owner EPS, Home Depot trades Below PAR (-8.3% discount to $374.47 PAR Value), providing an attractive 11.0% expected 5Y cycle IRR including 2.67% dividend yield.
